age.evidence: In total, 16 healthy heart regions from three adult male individuals (Supplementary Table 1) were collected less than 72 h postmortem during an autopsy after a court order.

cell_type.evidence: CD31-positive endothelial cells (ECs) were isolated using the CD31 MicroBead Kit (Miltenyi Biotec, Cat. No. 130-091-935) and the human FcR-Blocking Regent (Miltenyi Biotec, Cat.No. 130-059-901) in the MACS system (Miltenyi Biotec) according to the manufacturer’s instruction.
Adipose fibroblasts (AF) were isolated from subcutaneous fat tissue and cardiac fibroblasts (CF) were isolated from atrial samples.
Smooth muscle cells (SMCs) were isolated from the arteria mammaria interna (ITA).

developmental_stage.evidence: In total, 16 healthy heart regions from three adult male individuals (Supplementary Table 1) were collected less than 72 h postmortem during an autopsy after a court order.

disease_state.evidence: The hearts of the subjects did not present any relevant injury or signs of cardiac malfunction and were therefore defined as healthy.
Application of our heart map to an atrial fibrillation study revealed signatures of distinct mitochondrial dysfunctions.

material_type.evidence: All 16 heart regions dissected from three trauma victims were washed three times with cold PBS before being crushed in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle.
CFs, AFs, ECs, and SMCs were processed similarly to the heart tissue samples without liquid nitrogen crushing and FastPrep®-24 Instrument.

sample_source.evidence: All 16 heart regions dissected from three trauma victims were washed three times with cold PBS before being crushed in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle.
All biopsies from patients undergoing cardiovascular surgery were transferred within 10 min from the operation room in PBS.

sex.evidence: In total, 16 healthy heart regions from three adult male individuals (Supplementary Table 1) were collected less than 72 h postmortem during an autopsy after a court order.

tissue.evidence: Atrial samples from patients undergoing cardiovascular surgery were cut into 1–2-mm2 fragments and digested with 2 mg per ml of collagenase type II (Life Technologies, Cat. No. 17101-015, Carlsbad, CA) in PBS (1 h, 37 °C).
Adipose fibroblasts (AF) were isolated from subcutaneous fat tissue and cardiac fibroblasts (CF) were isolated from atrial samples.
